title: Tenant heatmap & sprint-lattice roadmap for private rollouts
creator: Aisha Navarro
description: This ticket coordinates a cross-functional quarterly plan that maps customer cohorts (tenant heatmap) to a tiled sprint-lattice model for Private/VPC/on-prem rollouts. Goal: produce a detailed, time-boxed roadmap that ties initiative-level OKRs (reliability, upgrade safety, activation velocity) to sprint tiles, acceptance gates, and measurable signals. Deliverables: 1) tenant heatmap with cohort scoring (compat, security, size, revenue tier), 2) sprint-lattice plan (2-week tiles aligned to eng/product/design owners), 3) gating criteria and rollback windows per tile, 4) OKR alignment doc tying success metrics to telemetry and QA prompts, 5) runbook artifacts for first three waves and a template for subsequent waves.
acceptance_criteria:
- Tenant heatmap created and validated with sales/customer-success for top 30 tenants
- Sprint-lattice plan published with owners for each tile and feature slice (deploy, upgrade, telemetry, docs)
- OKR mapping shows target metrics and telemetry queries for each workstream
- Risk and rollback criteria documented and agreed by SRE, Security, and Support
- Runbook prototype for Wave 1 tested in lab and playbook comments resolved
updates: 2026-02-26: Kickoff meeting with Eng (SRE, Runtime), PM, Design, Sales; agreed on cohort dimensions and scoring rubric. Action: Aisha to circulate rubric for feedback.
2026-03-02: Scoring rubric v1 posted to Confluence -> link below. Early feedback: Security flagged additional compliance dimension for regulated customers. Added to rubric.
2026-03-05: Design sketched sprint-tile visualization (low-fidelity); reviewed with PMs. Decision: use 2-week tiles, color-coded risk bands. PRD updated with visualization mockups.
2026-03-09: Eng capacity review — estimated 8 points per tile for core runtime changes (batching/compat); deferred low-priority telemetry enhancements to Q3 to reduce sprint friction.

2026-03-12: Goal alignment workshop with Sales and CS; validated top-20 tenant list and mapped three pilot cohorts (lighthouse, regulated, high-throughput). Prepared Wave 1 runbook outline for lab test next week. Liam assigned as rollout owner.
notes: Trade-offs discussed: prioritize compatibility slices (model variant compatibility, KV cache warming) over advanced telemetry in Wave 1 to minimize blast radius. Proposed experiment lanes: dark-launch upgrade path for 10% of traffic, manual activation baton for regulated cohorts. Need SRE sign-off on backout timing windows. Internal comms: draft customer-facing activation calendar to be shared after Wave 1 lab validation.
review_feedback: Design review (2026-03-06): simplify the heatmap legend and add a short legend for non-technical stakeholders. SRE (2026-03-10): require >=95th percentile latency baseline before enabling autoscaling in Wave 2. Sales (2026-03-11): request explicit onboarding checklist per tenant.
